body:
I used this some time before and every time was positive, except for being really drowsy. But one morning I decide to take more than I ever did before.  I took them at about 7:00 and not even 20 minutes later I felt somewhat delirious.  That continued for 30 minutes longer until it was about 8:00.  Then it really hit hard.  I became dizzy heavy and so pleasantly numb.  This is really all that happened.  I did see the occasional visual, like a fake fly, lots of floating lights.  There was no incredible giant spider and I wasnt afraid of zombies.  The only problem that happened was that someone said I looked out of it.  my eyes were bugging out and my pupils got dilated, but this only happens with higher doses.
